reviews.review:
After creating a couple characters and checking things out a little bit, I think this game has some potential. I'm the guy who played WoW as a lone wolf since BC so it's checking a lot of boxes. I like the art style and definitely like that I can re-scale and move the UI elements. I wish more games would do this. There is this new trend of ginormous UI elements, which drive me crazy. The UI shouldn't take up 1/3 of a 32" monitor in real 4K! 

A big bonus is NO SEASONS!!! PLEASE DON'T ADD THEM!

I've only done a handful of quests so far which are looking like your typical fetch it or go kill 5 of this type of quests. I'm yet to explore but definitely feel the urge. So far there are three glaring issues that may be dealbreakers. I'm unsure whether I will be keeping this despite liking a lot of what I see. After LE and Wolcen, I'm a little hesitant to pay for games in development. Granted the game is only $6.59 but it's the principle.

1. Cooldowns: All spells and melee abilities have cooldowns that are Much Much Much too long, not at all an enjoyable playstyle.
2. Distance Fog: So many games do this and I hate it. 
3. No bows or guns: Do you plan on adding them? I enjoy my mages but I always main a Pew Pew. 

Thank you for all the hard work so far! And thank you for asking for feedback! It will be interesting to see where this project goes!
